name: Duchy of Milan
description: A banner quartered: gold quarters bearing the black imperial eagle, white quarters bearing the blue biscione — a serpent devouring a man.
history: Banner of the Duchy of Milan under the Sforza (from 1450), quartering the imperial eagle with the Visconti serpent. The biscione remains Milan's most famous emblem.

features.role: imperial eagles in the gold quarters
the Visconti biscione in the white quarters
features.symbolism: the serpent of the Visconti, retained by the Sforza dukes
